**Stable ID:** `DATA-03.03` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 03 Modality coverage

Define identity, metadata and coverage rules for speech, music and general audio datasets.

## Deliverables

- Modality profile for speech and audio
- Speaker and recording-condition fields

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/TAXONOMY.md`
- `schemas/modalities/audio.schema.json`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Profile cites the documentation conventions it adopts

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Sample-rate, duration and channel units are explicit
- [ ] Speaker demographic fields are optional and never inferred
- [ ] Validator enforces the profile

## Non-goals

- Hosting audio samples
